Callout.Name: Weapon Found
Callout.Message: Knife handed in at a police station front desk.
Callout.Advisory: No offences, item to be disposed of.

Script.Line: I found the knife in the garden. It was in the flowerbed.
I brought it in because of the children. There are children next door.
I have not touched the blade. I picked it up by the handle.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has handed in a knife they found in their garden. It is paperwork, not a call, but it needs logging.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
